Name: Beans The Loveable NPC
Author: lusif1
Description:
::WHAT THIS MOD ADDS::
• A loveable NPC named Bean(s)• Tons of Dialogue• Custom Sprites designed by me, using Aseprite. 
•An incredible backstory that builds as you chat with her
•Soon there will be adorable events, and even custom quests that flesh out her story even further

::BACKSTORY:: 
Bean was born to a single mother, her father nowhere in sight. She was raised by said mother on Ferngill Island, which is located in the Fern Islands, and happens to be the biggest. When the war between Gotoro and the Ferngill Republic broke out however, the thought of her island being wiped from the earth by just a simple war plane was enough to cause her to move to Pelican Town, in Stardew Valley, for a more peaceful and simpler way of life. She'd been living there for a little over two seasons, when you, the player, moved into your grampas farm. I'm going to incorporate a lot of backstory into her events, and I might even have an event showing what happened to her mom after she left, and an event showing Bean meeting up with her dad, who may or may not reside in Stardew Valley!
